## What Bionic is

"Bionic is LM Studio's agent for open models. Natively local. Built for
creativity, work, and code." A separate app from LM Studio ("for advanced
low-level configuration, you can continue to use LM Studio alongside
Bionic"). Powered by the LM Studio runtime — MLX and llama.cpp.

- **Projects and sessions.** A project keeps sessions and files together;
  for code, *Allow coding* and a chosen root folder, after which the agent
  can "search the repository, edit files, use Git, and run shell commands
  in the selected working directory." Sessions open in tabs, run in the
  background, sit side by side, and fork.
- **Where the model runs**, per session: Local (downloaded in-app; no
  account, no credits), Remote (a local model on another device through LM
  Link), Cloud (LM Studio Secure Cloud, Zero Data Retention, credits from a
  signed-in account; the home page names GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4 Pro).
  "Local models and remote LM Link models do not consume credits and do
  not require billing set up."
- **Skills**: the Agent Skills format, `SKILL.md` plus optional files;
  "compatible skills you already use in other apps such as Codex and Claude
  Code"; `@` in the composer to invoke; Bionic can write one from a
  finished workflow or install one from a URL.
- **Documents**: created and edited in the project, auto-saved, shared
  across the project's sessions.
- **Voice**: local transcription with Voxtral (Mistral), multilingual.

## LM Studio as a server

OpenAI-compatible endpoints on `localhost:1234`; `lms server start`; a
setting to start the server headless at login (since 0.3.5); just-in-time
model loading when a request names a model. Requirements: Apple silicon
(Intel Macs not supported), macOS 13.4+ (14+ for MLX), 16 GB recommended,
8 GB workable for small models; Windows x64/ARM with AVX2, 16 GB; Linux x64
AppImage. Gemma 4 12B in the catalogue: 8.4M downloads, vision, tool use,
reasoning, "minimum system memory 7 GB". Hermes: `provider: lmstudio`,
optional `LM_API_KEY`.
